text:
sara: heads up — we just saw a KV hit-rate collapse on prod region-us-east-1 starting ~15:02 UTC after the 14:59 heuristic deploy. p90 latency spiked from 80ms -> 350ms and throughput dropped ~28%. cache.hits went from 92% -> 41% in ~7m.

dmitri: on it. which deploy? the batching heuristic tweak or the kernel selection update?

sara: batching heuristic (adaptive-window-size v2) rolled + kernel fallback toggle (prefer-small-kernel=true) in the same window. CI looked green, but lightweight load tests didn't hit cache patterns we have in prod.

jae: can we get the kv stats and a quick flame/profile snapshot? suspect the adaptive batching increased prefix churn which poisoned shards.

sara: pasted recent metrics (trimmed):
```
kv_prefix_hits: 41000
kv_prefix_misses: 59000
kv_evictions_per_min: 820
batch_window_ms: 12 -> 4 (after deploy)
kernel: small-optimized -> fallback-small (contains additional memcpy)
```

infra-bot: deploy r1234 to prod-us-east-1 finished at 14:59:11 UTC by marta.

marta: I toggled the fallback flag because we saw tail latency regression on A100 tests, thought the small kernel would avoid a larger memcpy for long sequences.

kevin: log excerpt from runtime around 15:05:
```
[15:04:58] incoming req tenant=acme prompt_len=72 kv_prefix=acct:acme:usr:  -> miss
[15:04:59] batch flush (size=1) because window shrunk
[15:05:01] evict shard=173 entry_count_drop=120
[15:05:03] miss for tenant=packr edge-case prefix mismatch (hashed key mismatch?)
```

dmitri: interesting — window shrink causing more small batches -> less prefix coalescing -> fewer reused KV entries -> higher memory pressure -> evictions. The kernel fallback might be increasing per-request memory churn, exacerbating eviction rate.

jae: can we repro quickly in staging with a synthetic tenant that mimics high-cardinality prefixes? I can run a ranger load with variable prefix skews.

sara: started a reproduce run in staging (staging-us-east-1) with 50k concurrent simulated users, skewed prefixes. attaching profiling snapshot link: https://internal/profiles/1835/a1 (flamegraph top: kv_cache::lookup 42%, memcpy 21%, batch_scheduler::flush 15%)

marta: note: the small kernel uses a temporary buffer per request for key packing; previously the optimized kernel reused a shared buffer slice. that memory allocation pattern will show in the flamegraph.

kevin: idea — revert the adaptive-window-size reduction (set window_ms back to 12) and enable a per-tenant batching override while we investigate. small change so low blast radius.

infra-bot: rollback r1234 to r1229 initiated by marta at 15:18:09 UTC.

dmitri: good. I'll also push a quick tweak to the KV eviction prioritizer to prefer keeping prefix hotness separated from random keys (cheap patch: tweak scoring: +penalty for last_access_age when prefix_count > 8).

jae: repro results: with window_ms=4 and small kernel -> hit-rate collapse reproduced in staging in ~4m. with window_ms=12 + small kernel -> hit-rate stable. with window_ms=4 + optimized kernel -> partial mitigation. confirms interaction.

sara: lesson: batching heuristics and kernel memory behavior interact nonlinearly. we need an integration test for prefix coalescing under small-window conditions.

marta: filed GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/4822 — title: "KV eviction spiral: batching window + small-kernel memory churn". adding labels: incident, perf, regression.

kevin: follow-ups:
- revert heuristic permanently or make it gated behind canary with prefix-skew detection
- add an evicter metric alert: evictions_per_min > 500 on any shard for >3m
- add unit/integration test ingest that stresses prefix reuse under small-batch windows

dmitri: I'll roll the prioritizer patch and add the evictions alert. jae, can you own the integration test + perf job?

jae: on it — will produce a small harness and a nightly that runs skewed workloads with both kernels and multiple window sizes. will also add a microbench for buffer allocations in both kernels.

sara: final status: rollback succeeded, prod p90 back to ~85ms, kv hits recovered to ~91% after 12m. keeping channel updated if anything else pops. :thumbsup:

marta: moving postmortem to /incident/1835-kv-eviction-regen, will include rootcause, timeline, and actions.

dmitri: retrospective action: add a small e2e matrix test that runs kernel variants x batching window configs on representative prefix distributions before enabling heuristics in prod canary.

sara: thanks all — will follow up with the postmortem draft.
